title: The Kaikoura UFOs - 1978
description:
The TRUE STORY of a world-famous UFO encounter off the Kaikoura Coast of Marlborough, New Zealand.  Told by the people who were actually there.

On the night of 30 December 1978, Argosy aircraft ZK-SAE - the "Merchant Enterprise"- with two pilots and a three-person television crew on board, was followed down the coast by a group of fast-moving and unexplained lights. At the same time the objects were being tracked  by ground radar stations, while the cameraman on board filmed them and the reported gave a live running commentary.

What were they?  Watch this film, then decide for yourself.  Written and produced by Paul Davidson.
